flags.subject: Anxiety Disorders in Adults: Screening: adults 64 years or younger, including pregnant and postpartum persons
flags.guideline: Anxiety Disorders in Adults: Screening: adults 64 years or younger, including pregnant and postpartum persons
flags.quote: The USPSTF recommends screening for anxiety disorders in adults, including pregnant and postpartum persons.

flags.subject: Anxiety in Children and Adolescents: Screening: children and adolescents aged 8 to 18 years
flags.guideline: Anxiety in Children and Adolescents: Screening: children and adolescents aged 8 to 18 years
flags.quote: The USPSTF recommends screening for anxiety in children and adolescents aged 8 to 18 years.

flags.subject: Aspirin Use to Prevent Preeclampsia and Related Morbidity and Mortality: Preventive Medication: pregnant persons at high risk for preeclampsia
flags.guideline: Aspirin Use to Prevent Preeclampsia and Related Morbidity and Mortality: Preventive Medication: pregnant persons at high risk for preeclampsia
flags.quote:
The USPSTF recommends the use of low-dose aspirin (81 mg/day) as preventive medication after 12 weeks of gestation in persons who are at high risk for preeclampsia.

See the Practice Considerations section for information on high risk and aspirin dose.

flags.subject: Breast Cancer: Screening: women aged 40 to 74 years
flags.guideline: Breast Cancer: Screening: women aged 40 to 74 years
flags.quote: The USPSTF recommends biennial screening mammography for women aged 40 to 74 years.

flags.subject: Breastfeeding: Primary Care Behavioral Counseling Interventions: pregnant and postpartum women
flags.guideline: Breastfeeding: Primary Care Behavioral Counseling Interventions: pregnant and postpartum women
flags.quote: The USPSTF recommends providing interventions or referrals, during pregnancy and after birth, to support breastfeeding.

flags.subject: Chlamydia and Gonorrhea: Screening: sexually active women, including pregnant persons
flags.guideline: Chlamydia and Gonorrhea: Screening: sexually active women, including pregnant persons
flags.quote: The USPSTF recommends screening for gonorrhea in all sexually active women 24 years or younger and in women 25 years or older who are at increased risk for infection.

flags.subject: Chlamydia and Gonorrhea: Screening: sexually active women, including pregnant persons
flags.guideline: Chlamydia and Gonorrhea: Screening: sexually active women, including pregnant persons
flags.quote: The USPSTF recommends screening for chlamydia in all sexually active women 24 years or younger and in women 25 years or older who are at increased risk for infection.

flags.subject: Colorectal Cancer: Screening: adults aged 45 to 49 years
flags.guideline: Colorectal Cancer: Screening: adults aged 45 to 49 years
flags.quote:
The USPSTF recommends screening for colorectal cancer in adults aged 45 to 49 years.

See the "Practice Considerations" section and Table 1 for details about screening strategies.

flags.subject: Colorectal Cancer: Screening: adults aged 50 to 75 years
flags.guideline: Colorectal Cancer: Screening: adults aged 50 to 75 years
flags.quote:
The USPSTF recommends screening for colorectal cancer in all adults aged 50 to 75 years.

See the "Practice Considerations" section and Table 1 for details about screening strategies.

flags.subject: Depression and Suicide Risk in Adults: Screening: adults, including pregnant and postpartum persons, and older adults (65 years or older)
flags.guideline: Depression and Suicide Risk in Adults: Screening: adults, including pregnant and postpartum persons, and older adults (65 years or older)
flags.quote: The USPSTF recommends screening for depression in the adult population, including pregnant and postpartum persons, as well as older adults.

flags.subject: Depression and Suicide Risk in Children and Adolescents: Screening: adolescents aged 12 to 18 years
flags.guideline: Depression and Suicide Risk in Children and Adolescents: Screening: adolescents aged 12 to 18 years
flags.quote: The USPSTF recommends screening for major depressive disorder (MDD) in adolescents aged 12 to 18 years.

flags.subject: Falls Prevention in Community-Dwelling Older Adults: Interventions: community-dwelling adults 65 years or older
flags.guideline: Falls Prevention in Community-Dwelling Older Adults: Interventions: community-dwelling adults 65 years or older
flags.quote: The USPSTF recommends exercise interventions to prevent falls in community-dwelling adults 65 years or older who are at increased risk for falls.

flags.subject: Folic Acid Supplementation to Prevent Neural Tube Defects: Preventive Medication: persons who plan to or could become pregnant
flags.guideline: Folic Acid Supplementation to Prevent Neural Tube Defects: Preventive Medication: persons who plan to or could become pregnant
flags.quote: The USPSTF recommends that all persons planning to or who could become pregnant take a daily supplement containing 0.4 to 0.8 mg (400 to 800 mcg) of folic acid.

flags.subject: Gestational Diabetes: Screening: asymptomatic pregnant persons at 24 weeks of gestation or after
flags.guideline: Gestational Diabetes: Screening: asymptomatic pregnant persons at 24 weeks of gestation or after
flags.quote: The USPSTF recommends screening for gestational diabetes in asymptomatic pregnant persons at 24 weeks of gestation or after.

flags.subject: Healthy Weight and Weight Gain In Pregnancy: Behavioral Counseling Interventions: pregnant persons
flags.guideline: Healthy Weight and Weight Gain In Pregnancy: Behavioral Counseling Interventions: pregnant persons
flags.quote: The USPSTF recommends that clinicians offer pregnant persons effective behavioral counseling interventions aimed at promoting healthy weight gain and preventing excess gestational weight gain in pregnancy.

flags.subject: High Body Mass Index in Children and Adolescents: Interventions: children and adolescents 6 years or older
flags.guideline: High Body Mass Index in Children and Adolescents: Interventions: children and adolescents 6 years or older
flags.quote:
The USPSTF recommends that clinicians provide or refer children and adolescents 6 years or older with a high body mass index (BMI) (≥95th percentile for age and sex) to comprehensive, intensive behavioral interventions.

See the Practice Considerations section for more information about behavioral interventions.

flags.subject: Hypertension in Adults: Screening: adults 18 years or older without known hypertension
flags.guideline: Hypertension in Adults: Screening: adults 18 years or older without known hypertension
flags.quote: The USPSTF recommends screening for hypertension in adults 18 years or older with office blood pressure measurement (OBPM). The USPSTF recommends obtaining blood pressure measurements outside of the clinical setting for diagnostic confirmation before starting treatment.

flags.subject: Hypertensive Disorders of Pregnancy: Screening: asymptomatic pregnant persons
flags.guideline: Hypertensive Disorders of Pregnancy: Screening: asymptomatic pregnant persons
flags.quote: The USPSTF recommends screening for hypertensive disorders in pregnant persons with blood pressure measurements throughout pregnancy.

flags.subject: Intimate Partner Violence and Caregiver Abuse of Older or Vulnerable Adults: Screening: women of reproductive age, including pregnant and postpartum women
flags.guideline: Intimate Partner Violence and Caregiver Abuse of Older or Vulnerable Adults: Screening: women of reproductive age, including pregnant and postpartum women
flags.quote:
The USPSTF recommends that clinicians screen for intimate partner violence (IPV) in women of reproductive age, including those who are pregnant and postpartum.

See the "Practice Considerations" section for information on evidence-based multicomponent interventions and for information on IPV in men.

flags.subject: Latent Tuberculosis Infection in Adults: Screening: asymptomatic adults at increased risk of latent tuberculosis infection (ltbi)
flags.guideline: Latent Tuberculosis Infection in Adults: Screening: asymptomatic adults at increased risk of latent tuberculosis infection (ltbi)
flags.quote:
The USPSTF recommends screening for LTBI in populations at increased risk.

See the "Assessment of Risk" section for additional information on adults at increased risk.

flags.subject: Lung Cancer: Screening: adults aged 50 to 80 years who have a 20 pack-year smoking history and currently smoke or have quit within the past 15 years
flags.guideline: Lung Cancer: Screening: adults aged 50 to 80 years who have a 20 pack-year smoking history and currently smoke or have quit within the past 15 years
flags.quote: The USPSTF recommends annual screening for lung cancer with low-dose computed tomography (LDCT) in adults aged 50 to 80 years who have a 20 pack-year smoking history and currently smoke or have quit within the past 15 years. Screening should be discontinued once a person has not smoked for 15 years or develops a health problem that substantially limits life expectancy or the ability or willingness to have curative lung surgery.

flags.subject: Osteoporosis to Prevent Fractures: Screening: postmenopausal women younger than 65 years with 1 or more risk factors for osteoporosis
flags.guideline: Osteoporosis to Prevent Fractures: Screening: postmenopausal women younger than 65 years with 1 or more risk factors for osteoporosis
flags.quote:
The USPSTF recommends screening for osteoporosis to prevent osteoporotic fractures in postmenopausal women younger than 65 years who are at increased risk for an osteoporotic fracture as estimated by clinical risk assessment.

See the "Practice Considerations" section for more information on risk assessment and screening tests.

flags.subject: Osteoporosis to Prevent Fractures: Screening: women 65 years or older
flags.guideline: Osteoporosis to Prevent Fractures: Screening: women 65 years or older
flags.quote:
The USPSTF recommends screening for osteoporosis to prevent osteoporotic fractures in women 65 years or older.

See the "Practice Considerations" section for more information on screening tests.

flags.subject: Prediabetes and Type 2 Diabetes: Screening: asymptomatic adults aged 35 to 70 years who have overweight or obesity
flags.guideline: Prediabetes and Type 2 Diabetes: Screening: asymptomatic adults aged 35 to 70 years who have overweight or obesity
flags.quote: The USPSTF recommends screening for prediabetes and type 2 diabetes in adults aged 35 to 70 years who have overweight or obesity. Clinicians should offer or refer patients with prediabetes to effective preventive interventions.

flags.subject: Prevention of Acquisition of HIV: Preexposure Prophylaxis: adolescents and adults at increased risk of hiv
flags.guideline: Prevention of Acquisition of HIV: Preexposure Prophylaxis: adolescents and adults at increased risk of hiv
flags.quote:
The USPSTF recommends that clinicians prescribe preexposure prophylaxis using effective antiretroviral therapy to persons who are at increased risk of HIV acquisition to decrease the risk of acquiring HIV.

See the Practice Considerations section for more information about identification of persons at increased risk and about effective antiretroviral therapy.

flags.subject: Prevention of Dental Caries in Children Younger Than 5 Years: Screening and Interventions: children younger than 5 years
flags.guideline: Prevention of Dental Caries in Children Younger Than 5 Years: Screening and Interventions: children younger than 5 years
flags.quote: The USPSTF recommends that primary care clinicians apply fluoride varnish to the primary teeth of all infants and children starting at the age of primary tooth eruption.

flags.subject: Prevention of Dental Caries in Children Younger Than 5 Years: Screening and Interventions: children younger than 5 years
flags.guideline: Prevention of Dental Caries in Children Younger Than 5 Years: Screening and Interventions: children younger than 5 years
flags.quote: The USPSTF recommends that primary care clinicians prescribe oral fluoride supplementation starting at age 6 months for children whose water supply is deficient in fluoride.

flags.subject: Statin Use for the Primary Prevention of Cardiovascular Disease in Adults: Preventive Medication: adults aged 40 to 75 years who have 1 or more cardiovascular risk factors and an estimated 10-year cardiovascular disease (cvd) risk of 10% or greater
flags.guideline: Statin Use for the Primary Prevention of Cardiovascular Disease in Adults: Preventive Medication: adults aged 40 to 75 years who have 1 or more cardiovascular risk factors and an estimated 10-year cardiovascular disease (cvd) risk of 10% or greater
flags.quote: The USPSTF recommends that clinicians prescribe a statin for the primary prevention of CVD for adults aged 40 to 75 years who have 1 or more CVD risk factors (i.e. dyslipidemia, diabetes, hypertension, or smoking) and an estimated 10-year risk of a cardiovascular event of 10% or greater.

flags.subject: Syphilis Infection During Pregnancy: Screening: asymptomatic pregnant women
flags.guideline: Syphilis Infection During Pregnancy: Screening: asymptomatic pregnant women
flags.quote: The USPSTF recommends early, universal screening for syphilis infection during pregnancy; if an individual is not screened early in pregnancy, the USPSTF recommends screening at the first available opportunity.

flags.subject: Syphilis Infection in Nonpregnant Adolescents and Adults: Screening: asymptomatic, nonpregnant adolescents and adults who are at increased risk for syphilis infection
flags.guideline: Syphilis Infection in Nonpregnant Adolescents and Adults: Screening: asymptomatic, nonpregnant adolescents and adults who are at increased risk for syphilis infection
flags.quote: The USPSTF recommends screening for syphilis infection in persons who are at increased risk for infection.

flags.subject: Tobacco Smoking Cessation in Adults, Including Pregnant Persons: Interventions: nonpregnant adults
flags.guideline: Tobacco Smoking Cessation in Adults, Including Pregnant Persons: Interventions: nonpregnant adults
flags.quote: The USPSTF recommends that clinicians ask all adults about tobacco use, advise them to stop using tobacco, and provide behavioral interventions and US Food and Drug Administration (FDA)--approved pharmacotherapy for cessation to nonpregnant adults who use tobacco.

flags.subject: Tobacco Smoking Cessation in Adults, Including Pregnant Persons: Interventions: pregnant persons
flags.guideline: Tobacco Smoking Cessation in Adults, Including Pregnant Persons: Interventions: pregnant persons
flags.quote: The USPSTF recommends that clinicians ask all pregnant persons about tobacco use, advise them to stop using tobacco, and provide behavioral interventions for cessation to pregnant persons who use tobacco.
